title: DynamicDisasters
description: Experience extreme, physics-based natural disasters like tornadoes and cosmic rifts in 1.21.1 – zero custom textures, fully shader-optimized!
body:
## 🌪️ DynamicDisasters

**DynamicDisasters** brings the unpredictable, raw power of nature straight into your Minecraft world! This mod adds highly dynamic, visually stunning natural disasters driven by real-time physics and advanced particle manipulation.

The best part? **This mod requires absolutely no custom textures or external resource packs!** Everything is rendered using vanilla blocks, pure code logic, and smart particle handling. It fits perfectly into the vanilla aesthetic while adding extreme, cinematic danger.

---

### 🔥 Dimensional Disasters

*   **The Overworld (The Tornado):** A devastating vortex tears through the biomes, ripping up actual blocks (dirt, grass, wood) and turning them into spinning physics objects. Entities and mobs get sucked right into the funnel!
*   **The Nether (Nether Superstorm):** An apocalyptic tempest of flame and lava particles. The very roof of the Nether begins to crack, raining down magma blocks and lava pockets like a volcanic collapse.
*   **The End (Cosmic Rift):** A gravitational singularity tears open the sky, generating a massive gravity well. Players and Endermen are helplessly pulled toward the center while reality distorts around the rift.

---

### 💻 Performance & Compatibility

*   **Shader Ready:** Built-in hooks for Iris/Oculus API. The mod automatically detects if you are using shaders and dynamically scales particle density for maximum visual impact.
*   **Server Friendly:** Highly optimized block-to-entity loops ensure your server’s TPS stays rock solid, even during the peak of a storm.
